subject: Day out
author: Xandu
body:
It was really cool meeting up for a community day today.

I enjoyed doing some offline stunt runs and marked man events in Paradise City today. Took some risks, did some cool stunts and racked up the millions. Too bad you missed the most memorable moment. I did a 360 flat spin of the first ramp on the S. Bay Express Way bridge… kind of messed it up and landed half way on the rail and was grinding the edge for a while… then fell off (this is when you would normally crash!) and back down on the other side of the ramp and then get shot on to the next ramp where I do another 360 flatspin and land it perfectly… and the reward? 5x multiplier. Words doesn’t really do this justice…

I really look forward to online Stunt Run in Cagney. Imagine doing what I did today with 7 other people online. I think that will be lots of fun… especially when you have 5 000 000 points and someone comes and takes you down. YAY! It is a interesting twist to the game mode because it makes it possible for people that are not masters at Stunt Run to win.

See you at our next community day. I guess Cagney and possibly Davis will be played and maybe some Rock Band with Drums and Vocals. Another face-off on Burnout 2: Point of Impact would be cool too…🙂

-- The Creator --
